description: Five-launch FP32 GDN-2 chunk prefill with stable causal scores and exact triangular solve.

initial_state.note: K-major, read-only and never aliased with final_state.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

final_state.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Token-major BTHD inputs/output; K-major BHKV state; all tensors contiguous.
domain.gate_domain: Finite g<=0, erase_gate in [0,2], w in [0,1].
domain.normalization: q and k are normalized in FP32 with eps=1e-6; q is then scaled by 128^-0.5.
domain.ownership: Independent complete chunk/head tiles; scan owns complete heads across chunks.
domain.aliasing: Inputs are read-only; o and final_state are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: All arithmetic/state are FP32, but CCE register reductions may differ from the CPU reduction tree; bitwise equality is not required.

support.note: All five dynamic-shape stages compiled and executed for all contract cases at block_dim=1 and 8 on 950PR_9589 V100 / CANN 9.2.0; block_dim=2 and 4 remain unqualified.
Native source check at block_dim=8 on 950PR_9589 V100 / CANN 9.2.0; other block counts unqualified.

measured.static: All five optimized stages emitted; zero static errors/warnings. Surface operations: prepare 174, scores 128, WY 128, scan 153, output 122.
measured.simulation: Optimized source passes sim T=1/H=1 and pipesim T=2/H=1 plus T=65/H=16 at block_dim=1, checking all 13 stage outputs and synchronization diagnostics.
measured.board_cce: Optimized kernel SHA256 a1f305eb5209420e026a1a6c82d7147f00a00c0588ea7f7f331805993d1cce5b passes a fresh canonical source check at T=4096/H=16/FP32/block_dim=8 on 950PR_9589 V100/CANN compiler+OPP 9.2.0, against CPU Torch 2.12.0 references: output relative L2 2.400727462e-6/max abs 1.345761120e-7; state relative L2 4.140812156e-6/max abs 4.950910807e-6. All 13 intermediate comparisons also pass. The original 9ba48cd WY failure is retained. Remaining canonical board-launcher cases are untested; see native_inprocess for separate bridge evidence.
measured.latency: Same-process Torch NPU synchronized baseline-candidate-baseline, 3 rounds, warmup=10/repeat=50, FP32/B=1/H=16/K=V=128/block_dim=8, 950PR_9589 V100/CANN compiler+OPP 9.2.0: T=1024 candidate medians 3876.824..3882.246 us (8.422..8.581% lower latency); T=4096 candidate medians 14178.686..14308.423 us (8.845..10.162% lower latency). Each reduction uses the faster of the two same-round accepted GD2-01 chunk baselines. CPU goldens pass before timing; public validation/allocation/launches are included. Raw report SHA256 b2d4a6f88f1ea499b66ec52bf1a6ef100dc5be3e76ba048da10f530f4fd75fce. This comparison is separate from GD2-01's Torch NPU recurrence baseline.
measured.whole_model: CPU real-checkpoint gate replay passes both random and natural-text samples at T=4096, all 18 layers and reset sizes 4/8/16/32/64 (180 rows), against both CPU oracles. Native whole-model logit/cache qualification remains pending.
measured.reproduce: run.py check --launcher board --board a5 --case t4096_h16_prefill --block-dim 8; see docs/research/gdn2_chunk_fwd_gate_range.md
measured.native_inprocess: All 12 contract cases pass all 13 CPU-golden stage comparisons at block_dim=1 and 8; every stage output is byte-identical between these block counts and versus accepted GD2-01. Kernel SHA256 a1f305eb5209420e026a1a6c82d7147f00a00c0588ea7f7f331805993d1cce5b. Maximum final output/state relative L2 across cases: 3.348794618e-6/5.677315394e-6. This NPU in-process bridge evidence is separate from the canonical board launcher above. Other block counts remain unqualified.

optimization.change: FP32 vector row preweights in existing scan key/output query UB allocations; unchanged sum order, workspace, launches and public ABI.
optimization.reproduce: benchmark.py --baseline <accepted-GD2-01-stages.py> --output tmp/GD2-03/sandwich.json; see research document for same-process identity and raw receipt hashes.

gate_range.source: Real 95B checkpoint; CPU Torch 2.12.0, BF16 model, FP32 captured core tensors; sample qualification only

provenance.disposition: Independent FP32 equations and causal score construction; no Triton dependency.
Independent recurrence oracle and runtime input generator adapted to long sequences.

release_scope.note: Repository-owned experimental unit; scoped A5 native correctness and FP32 performance qualification only, as listed in support/measured.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

workspace.lifetime: One public call; each stage output has a unique producer, separate storage and launch-ordered consumers.

saved_state.states: Incoming K-major FP32 state per chunk, consumed by output stage.

validation.numerics: Independent FP32 chunk-vs-recurrent tests cover T=1,16,63,64,65,127,128,192,320,1024,4096 at H=16 for zero/strong decay, budget 1e-4. FLA naive recurrence is separately checked. These host tests do not promote unexecuted CCE cases.
validation.synchronization: Reduced block_dim=1 pipesim diagnostics compare all 13 stage outputs; event balance, hazards and deadlock checks pass for the explicitly scoped cases.
validation.hardware: 950PR_9589 V100, CANN compiler and OPP 9.2.0; OPP contains ascend950, ascend910b and ascend910_93. CPU Torch goldens, Torch NPU performance. Canonical board T4096/bd8 and in-process all 12 cases/bd1+8 pass; other block counts and native whole-model qualification remain untested.
